official_definition: You can target any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates and battle them simultaneously. When you've done so, during this battle, the cores on the targets targeted by this effect can't be moved.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Rekka Consecutive Blade] or [Rekka Consecutive Blade: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Rekka Consecutive Blade]", "give [Rekka Consecutive Blade]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
